high_level_description: This image showcases a plate of nigiri sushi, a popular Japanese dish consisting of small pieces of raw fish (sashimi) served on top of a small mound of rice. The plate is transparent and rectangular, placed on a woven placemat with a dark and light brown pattern. The sushi pieces are labeled with the names of the fish they represent: Shrimp (top left) Cuttlefish (top center) Cod (top right) Salmon (middle left) Tuna (bottom right) The sushi is garnished with green leaves, likely for aesthetic appeal and to add a fresh element to the presentation
